metadata.title: Kronik — Explore World History
metadata.description: An interactive educational website about world history. Explore maps, timelines, and verified historical articles.

hero.title: Explore World History
hero.subtitle: Learn about the key events that shaped human civilization through interactive maps, timelines, and in-depth articles.

features.title: A New Way to Learn History
features.subtitle: History is more than memorization. Kronik presents world history visually, interactively, and with verified sources.

map.title: Interactive Map
map.description: Explore historical locations around the world. Click to see events that happened there.

timeline.title: Civilization Timeline
timeline.description: Slide from 3000 BCE to the present. See how civilizations rose and fell.

articles.title: Verified Articles
articles.description: Every article includes academic references and confidence level badges.

cta.title: Ready to Explore History?
cta.subtitle: Begin your journey through 5000 years of human civilization.

footer.description: An open-source educational website about world history.
